answer.answer: Total qualifying income across this package is $199,000.00, drawn from the two 2025 W-2 Box 1 figures: $103,000.00 for Lena Fictus and $96,000.00 for Omar Fictus. Payslips and bank statements are present in the package but are treated as corroborating documents only and are not included in the sum.
caveats: Both W-2s are for tax year 2025; no earlier-year W-2s were found in the package.
Payslip and bank statement documents are present but excluded from qualifying income per the package definition.
One bank statement unit is held (PII gate) and was not inspected, but bank deposits are excluded from qualifying income regardless.
